name: Supportiv
one_liner: Supportiv puts you in a small, anonymous text chat with peers facing the same issue, led by a trained moderator, any time of day.
best_for: People who want to talk to someone right now, anonymously, without signing up
People feeling isolated with a specific struggle (caregiving, grief, stress, loneliness)
People not ready for therapy who want to hear from others in the same situation
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who need diagnosis, therapy or medication
People who prefer voice or video over text chat
short_description: Anonymous, moderated peer chats matched by topic, 24/7. Free through some employers and plans; otherwise a $24 day pass (2025 listing).
long_description: Supportiv is a US web-based peer support service. You describe what you are struggling with, and it places you in a small, live, text-only chat with people dealing with similar things, plus a trained moderator. No name, email or phone number is needed, and identifying details are not allowed in chats. Many people get it free through an employer, health plan or other sponsor; for individuals, a Mental Health America listing (2025) gave a $24 pass for 24 hours of unlimited chats. Supportiv says it does not sell or share personal data and that sponsors see only anonymous topic summaries. Studies by Supportiv's own researchers report short-term drops in loneliness during chats, but none had a control group. It is not therapy and not crisis support.
patient_summary: You type what is on your mind and are matched within minutes to a small anonymous chat with others going through something similar, kept on track by a trained moderator. It is peer support, not therapy or crisis care, and you don't need to give your name or email. It is free if your employer, health plan or another organisation sponsors it; otherwise a 24-hour pass was listed at $24.

pricing.starting_price: $24 for a 24-hour pass, or free through some employers and health plans
pricing.notes: Day pass price from a Mental Health America listing (Aug 2025); not confirmed on Supportiv's own site. Free, unlimited use when an employer, health plan or other organisation sponsors it.

privacy.notes: Supportiv says it never sells or shares personal data, needs no name or email, and gives sponsors only aggregate topic summaries. It claims HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance (self-reported); full policy text not reviewed.

seo.title: Supportiv: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: Supportiv offers anonymous, moderated 24/7 peer support chats that match you with people going through something similar.

faqs.a: About $15/day, or free through some employers and plans. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Supportiv before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Supportiv replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Supportiv is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
Supportiv is available on the web.
24/7 anonymous chats; Matched by topic; Trained moderators; English, Spanish and French.

clinical_trials.study: Momentary loneliness during Supportiv chats among adults 65 and older

citation.authors: Supportiv-employed researchers (full author list not verified)
citation.title: Role of Synchronous, Moderated, and Anonymous Peer Support Chats on Reducing Momentary Loneliness in Older Adults: Retrospective Observational Study

clinical_trials.outcome: Loneliness and optimism ratings improved after about 8 to 9 minutes of chatting; small-group chats did better than one-to-one after about 20 minutes. No control group; all authors employed by Supportiv.

primary_uses: Anonymous peer chat about a specific struggle
Talking through stress, grief or caregiving

availability.note: Web-based, 24/7, in the US. Free when sponsored by an employer or plan; otherwise paid.
